final: WITH store_counts AS (SELECT store_id, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customer GROUP BY store_id), totals AS (SELECT SUM(customer_count) AS total_customers FROM store_counts), shares AS (SELECT sc.store_id, sc.customer_count, 1.0 * sc.customer_count / t.total_customers AS store_share FROM store_counts sc JOIN totals t ON t.total_customers IS NOT NULL), avg_shares AS (SELECT AVG(store_share) AS average_share FROM shares), qualifying AS (SELECT s.store_id, s.customer_count, s.store_share, s.store_share - a.average_share AS share_difference FROM shares s JOIN avg_shares a ON a.average_share IS NOT NULL WHERE s.store_share > a.average_share) SELECT store_id, customer_count, store_share, share_difference FROM qualifying ORDER BY share_difference DESC LIMIT 10
